_comment: Classical-compressor sizes for the learn page's 'why not just zip it' table,
for the HN worked-example URL (scripts/numbers.ts's HN_URL).
raw/deflate/gzip are NOT read from here — scripts/numbers.ts re-measures them
with node's own bundled zlib on every run, which is deterministic for a given
node release. They are recorded below only so a drift is visible: the generator
compares its measurement against these and fails loudly if they disagree.
bzip2 and xz have no node stdlib implementation, so they are vendored facts
rather than re-measured. Provenance: measured once with the tools named in
'bzip2_tool'/'xz_tool' below, on the same 45-byte input. Both are far larger
than the input (the point of the table), so a small version-to-version drift
would not change what the section says.
